The v5 corpus retains the frozen v16-selection atlas, cells and layout-1 recipe.
Only its authoring header is promoted from 4 to 5: migration v5 changes only
that header for layout-1 files. PNGs remain the immutable v16-selection files;
these files must not be regenerated with current smart detection or baking.
The v1–v3 corpus is in v15 and the v4 corpus is v16-selection.
